channel.title: Navan Badminton Club
channel.description: Welcome to Navan Badminton Club located at Claremont Stadium in Navan, Co. Meath, Ireland. Club nights every Monday and Wednesday during the season which runs from September to April. Club caters for Adults and Juveniles of all standards from beginner to advanced.

item.title: Meath Badminton: Leinster CAC Intercounty Finals – 22nd March
item.description: This Sunday (22nd March), Meath competes in the Leinster CAC Intercounty Finals in Baldoyle and Tolka Rovers, with club members representing the county across every grade. Semi-finals start at 10am, finals at 2pm—best of luck to all teams. An Mhí Abú!
item.author: badminton@navanbadmintonclub.com (Navan Badminton Club)

item.title: Leinster CAC Intercounty Prelims – Meath & Navan Players in Action (22nd February)
item.description: The Leinster CAC Intercounty Prelims take place this Sunday, 22nd February, across Meath, Dublin and Wicklow. Navan is represented in Meath’s Grade 3, 5A and 5B panels as they aim to join other Meath teams already qualified for Finals Day in March.
item.author: badminton@navanbadmintonclub.com (Navan Badminton Club)

item.title: Incredible Weekend at the Leinster CAC Graded Individuals!
item.description: Our players showcased exceptional talent and sportsmanship at the Leinster CAC Graded Individuals, bringing home several accolades. A massive shoutout to Miriam Keogan for her dual victories!
item.author: badminton@navanbadmintonclub.com (Navan Badminton Club)

item.title: Almost Time for the Big Day!
item.description: Wishing good luck to Meath teams at the Leinster CAC Inter County Finals Day, with Navan Badminton Club players representing across various grades.

item.title: Leinster CAC Preliminaries This Sunday!
item.description: Navan players represent Meath in the Leinster CAC Preliminaries this Sunday,with participation across all panels. Good luck to all Meath teams!
